notFound.title: Oops! Page not found.
notFound.description: Looks like the page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved. But don't worry — we're here to help you get back on track.

serverError.title: 500 – Internal Server Error
serverError.description: Oops! Something went wrong on our side. Our system hit a temporary glitch. We're already working to fix it. Please try again in a few minutes or contact our support team if the issue persists.
